I’m putting together an all-black going-out outfit and want to build the look deliberately around the dress first to make sure everything feels cohesive. 

1. On Princess Polly, find a black short party dress in size Medium that’s actually available for delivery. Please open the product page so you can verify the size and delivery status, and leave that tab open so I can keep the dress as my anchor piece.
2. Next, go to DemoniaCult and find a pair of black Mary Jane shoes that work well with the dress. Check that size 9 or 9.5 is available directly on the product page, and open the best option in its own tab so I can compare the vibe side by side with the dress; be sure to note exactly which of those sizes you found in stock. As long as the live size and delivery checks pass on the page, don't worry about researching return policies or marketplace fine print—I'd much rather go with a bolder, more unique silhouette.
3. Then, head to Edikted and select a dark brown leather oversized jacket without a hood for the outer layer, opening the actual product page so I can visually confirm it fits the overall look.

At the end, please send me a short outfit summary with the product names and links for all three items, include the dress and shoe prices, and mention the exact shoe size availability you found on DemoniaCult.
